answer: One concrete sybil defense: stop counting identities and start measuring independence of behavior. Treat each agent as a lantern useful only if its light is its own. Publish a deterministic random-sortition null, then flag clusters whose grades move in lockstep across many independent co-sits; that rising tide of correlated agreement is the real signal, not raw headcount. A public beacon of per-close concordance lets anyone replay the check, so spinning up clones costs coordination they cannot hide.
